# Meltwater

> Meltwater is a unified intelligence platform for PR, communications, and marketing teams. It brings together media, social, influencer, and AI-search signals — combining AI analysis with human expertise — so organizations can see the full picture, understand what it means, and act with confidence.

Meltwater serves more than 27,000 organizations across 130+ countries. The links below provide the primary English-language sources for understanding the company, platform, products, capabilities, and common use cases.

## Platform and company overview

- [Meltwater homepage](https://www.meltwater.com/en): Overview of Meltwater's media, social, consumer, influencer, and AI intelligence solutions.
- [Meltwater Intelligence Platform](https://www.meltwater.com/en/platform): How Meltwater unifies media, social, influencer, and AI-search signals in one platform.
- [Why Meltwater](https://www.meltwater.com/en/why-meltwater): The platform's approach to data, AI-powered insights, global coverage, and connected workflows.
- [All Meltwater products and features](https://www.meltwater.com/en/products): Index of Meltwater products, capabilities, and use cases.
- [Mira AI](https://www.meltwater.com/en/ai): Meltwater's AI assistant for turning media, social, and AI-search data into source-linked insights and reports.
- [Meltwater integrations and API](https://www.meltwater.com/en/platform/integrations-api): Options for connecting Meltwater data and intelligence with other workflows and systems.

## Media intelligence and PR

- [Media Monitoring](https://www.meltwater.com/en/products/media-monitoring): Real-time monitoring and analysis across online news, print, broadcast, podcasts, social media, and other sources.
- [Media Intelligence](https://www.meltwater.com/en/capabilities/media-intelligence): Connected monitoring, analysis, and reporting for PR and communications teams.
- [Media Relations](https://www.meltwater.com/en/capabilities/media-relations): Journalist discovery, media-list management, pitching, outreach, and relationship workflows.
- [Media Database](https://www.meltwater.com/en/products/media-database): Searchable journalist and media-contact data for targeted PR outreach.
- [Press Release Distribution](https://www.meltwater.com/en/products/press-distribution): Press-release distribution with targeting, reporting, and monitoring workflows.
- [PR Reporting](https://www.meltwater.com/en/products/pr-reporting): Real-time PR analytics and reporting for measuring coverage, reputation, campaigns, and competitive performance.
- [Custom Reports](https://www.meltwater.com/en/products/custom-reports): Bespoke, analyst-supported reporting designed for executives and other stakeholders.
- [Real-Time Alerting](https://www.meltwater.com/en/products/real-time-alerting): Automated alerts for important mentions, unusual activity, emerging issues, and narrative changes.
- [Newsletters and Newsfeeds](https://www.meltwater.com/en/products/newsletters): Tools for curating monitored coverage into branded newsletters, briefings, and website newsfeeds.

## Social and consumer intelligence

- [Social Listening](https://www.meltwater.com/en/capabilities/social-listening): Analysis of social conversations to understand audiences, brand perception, competitors, and emerging trends.
- [Social Media Monitoring](https://www.meltwater.com/en/products/social-media-monitoring): Monitoring across major global and regional social platforms.
- [Social Media Analytics](https://www.meltwater.com/en/products/social-media-analytics): Reporting and analysis of owned social-channel performance alongside broader media and campaign data.
- [Consumer Insights](https://www.meltwater.com/en/products/consumer-insights): Audience, market, and consumer research based on continuously updated online conversations and behavioral signals.
- [Explore+](https://www.meltwater.com/en/products/explore-plus): Enterprise-scale analytics for complex media, social, consumer, and market-intelligence research.

## Influencer marketing

- [Influencer Marketing](https://www.meltwater.com/en/capabilities/influencer-marketing): End-to-end influencer discovery, vetting, relationship management, campaign execution, and measurement.
- [Influencer Management](https://www.meltwater.com/en/products/social-influencers): Meltwater's influencer-management software for managing creators and demonstrating campaign impact.

## AI visibility and connected AI workflows

- [AI Visibility Tracking](https://www.meltwater.com/en/capabilities/ai-visibility-tracking): Monitor and improve how brands appear across AI assistants and AI-search experiences.
- [GenAI Lens](https://www.meltwater.com/en/products/genai-lens): Track brand visibility, citations, sentiment, prompts, and competitive share of voice across leading AI platforms.
- [Meltwater MCP](https://www.meltwater.com/en/products/mcp): Connect governed Meltwater intelligence with supported AI assistants and natural-language workflows.
- [Mira Studio product tour](https://www.meltwater.com/en/product-tours/mira-studio): Guided demonstration of Meltwater's AI-powered teammate for research, analysis, briefings, and reporting.
- [AI Visibility Tracking product tour](https://www.meltwater.com/en/product-tours/ai-visibility-tracking): Guided demonstration of Meltwater's AI-visibility monitoring workflow.

## Business use cases

- [AI Visibility and Content Optimization](https://www.meltwater.com/en/use-case/ai-visibility): Understand AI-generated brand narratives and the sources influencing them.
- [Brand Monitoring and Reputation Management](https://www.meltwater.com/en/use-case/brand-monitoring): Detect risks, track brand perception, and manage reputation across media and social channels.
- [Consumer Intelligence and Trend Detection](https://www.meltwater.com/en/use-case/consumer-intelligence): Identify audience needs, cultural shifts, market signals, and emerging trends.
- [Influencer Management and Campaign ROI](https://www.meltwater.com/en/use-case/influencer-management): Find creators, run influencer programs, and measure campaign performance.
- [Media Relations and Outreach Impact](https://www.meltwater.com/en/use-case/media-relations): Improve journalist targeting and evaluate the results of media outreach.

## Authoritative resources

- [Meltwater resources](https://www.meltwater.com/en/resources): Research reports, guides, webinars, and other educational resources.
- [Ultimate Guide to Media Monitoring](https://www.meltwater.com/en/resources/ultimate-guide-to-media-monitoring): Foundational guide to media monitoring strategy, workflows, and measurement.
- [State of PR 2026](https://www.meltwater.com/en/resources/state-of-pr): Research based on responses from 1,100 PR professionals about the changing communications industry.
- [Meltwater blog](https://www.meltwater.com/en/blog): Articles and research covering media intelligence, PR, social media, marketing, consumer insights, and AI visibility.
- [LLM Monitoring](https://www.meltwater.com/en/blog/llm-monitoring): Introduction to monitoring brand presence and performance across large language models.
- [How to Track LLM Brand Mentions](https://www.meltwater.com/en/blog/how-to-track-llm-brand-mentions): Practical guidance for measuring brand mentions in AI-generated responses.
- [Social Listening Tools](https://www.meltwater.com/en/blog/top-social-listening-tools): Comparison and evaluation guidance for social-listening platforms.
- [PR Monitoring](https://www.meltwater.com/en/blog/pr-monitoring): Explanation of PR monitoring, its applications, and how teams evaluate coverage.
- [Brand Reputation Measurement](https://www.meltwater.com/en/blog/reputation-measurement): Frameworks and tools for measuring brand reputation.
- [Customer stories](https://www.meltwater.com/en/customer-stories): Examples of how organizations use Meltwater across PR, media intelligence, social intelligence, and influencer marketing.

## Pricing and contact

- [Meltwater pricing](https://www.meltwater.com/en/pricing): Official information about Meltwater's customizable pricing approach.
- [Meltwater pricing guide](https://www.meltwater.com/en/blog/meltwater-pricing): Explanation of the factors that influence packages and pricing.
- [Request a demo](https://www.meltwater.com/en/request-demo): Request a tailored demonstration of Meltwater products and workflows.
- [Contact Meltwater](https://www.meltwater.com/en/about/contact-us): Contact options for products, support, partnerships, and general inquiries.

## Optional

- [Our story](https://www.meltwater.com/en/our-story): Meltwater's company background and development since 2001.
- [Meltwater news](https://www.meltwater.com/en/news): Current company news and announcements.
- [Product updates](https://www.meltwater.com/en/product-updates): Recent improvements and additions across Meltwater products.
- [Partner network](https://www.meltwater.com/en/partner-network): Meltwater's technology, data, and services partner ecosystem.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.meltwater.com/en/privacy): Information about Meltwater's privacy and data-handling practices.
- [Product-specific terms](https://www.meltwater.com/en/product-specific-terms): Terms that apply to particular Meltwater products and services.
